hypotheses.S0_full_attention_adds_semantic_informat: The full operator state exceeds the residual-only state by at least 0.01 median AUROC at four or more layers.
hypotheses.S1_one_head_captures_half_attention_gain: Among feature-layer cells where full attention adds at least 0.01 AUROC, a validation-selected head captures at least half that gain in at least 50 percent of cells.
hypotheses.S2_raw_head_semantics_were_residual_conf: Head-delta-only AUROC is at least 0.05 below residual-plus-head AUROC in at least 75 percent of feature-layer cells.
hypotheses.S3_increment_survives_current_token_cont: Residual-plus-selected-head improves within-current-token AUROC by at least 0.01 in at least 20 percent of competent feature-layer cells.
hypotheses.S4_validation_head_selection_generalizes: The validation-selected head ranks in the top three evaluation heads for incremental AUROC in at least 50 percent of feature-layer cells.
hypotheses.S5_large_unique_single_head_roles_exist: At least ten feature-layer cells gain at least 0.03 held-out AUROC and 0.01 within-token AUROC from one selected head over residual alone.
